title: HunterZ Underground
description: HunterZ Underground is the predecessor modpack of WayZ
body:
## HunterZ Underground

HunterZ Underground was a French post-apocalyptic roleplay server active back in 2017. While official support has concluded, this modpack serves as a preservation project—a way to keep the memories alive and revisit the world we built.

Because we didn't use any custom mods at the time, this pack accurately recreates the exact 2017 experience using classic mods from that era.

---

### Key Features & Included Mods

* **Firepower:** Flan's Mod & Vic's Modern Warfare for intense post-apocalyptic gunplay.
* **Immersive Roleplay:** Custom NPCs and Gliby's Voice Chat to bring the world to life.
* **World Building & Decoration:** BiblioCraft and MrCrayfish’s Furniture Mod to flesh out your bases and safe zones.
* **Atmosphere:** Better Foliage and Dynamic Surroundings for a gritty, immersive environment.
* **...and many more** classic 2017 mods!

> **Note:** This modpack features our original, custom Resource Pack designed specifically to enhance the bleak, post-apocalyptic ambiance.

---

### Missing mods you need to install

Few developers made their mod inaccesible from Modrinth. You'll need to install them directly:
- [MoCreatures](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mo-creatures)
- [CustomMobSpawner](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/custom-mob-spawner)
- [Bibliocraft](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bibliocraft)
- [Flan's Mod](https://www.flansmod.com/)
- [Optifine](http://adfoc.us/serve/sitelinks/?id=475250&url=http://optifine.net/adloadx?f=OptiFine_1.7.10_HD_U_E7.jar&x=72c1)
- [Thirst mod](https://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding-java-edition/minecraft-mods/1282656-thirst-mod-1-8-15-updated-to-minecraft-1-8-100k)
- [Stalker Models](https://github.com/WayZ-Minecraft/stalker-models/releases/download/Combined/Stalker.Models.jar)
